description: Renovate config for cortex-tenant — single Go module + Dockerfile. Pattern
derived from project-468/468-platform self-hosted renovate setup. Covers Go
module updates, Docker base-image bumps, and GitHub Actions. Requires the
self-hosted renovate workflow (renovate.yml) to be present.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes bypass the weekly schedule and ship as soon as a patched version exists.

dependencyDashboardHeader: This issue lists Renovate updates and detected dependencies. Read the [Dependency Dashboard](https://docs.renovatebot.com/key-concepts/dashboard/) docs to learn more.
dependencyDashboardFooter: - [ ] <!-- rebase-check -->If you want to rebase/retry any failed PRs, check this box

packageRules.description: Isolate major bumps into their own PRs (breaking risk) and give them a longer soak.
Group non-major Go module updates into one weekly PR.
Group GitHub Actions updates and auto-merge patch/pin bumps.
Group Docker base images with a short soak for non-major.
Docker major bumps get the standard 7-day soak.
